name: Meganium
flavor_text: Anyone who stands beside it becomes refreshed, just as if they were soaking in the soothing atmosphere of a forest.

text.name: Wild Growth
text.text: Each Basic {G} Energy attached to all of your Pokémon provides {G}{G} Energy. The effect of Wild Growth doesn't stack.

name: Inteleon
flavor_text: It uses special lenses in its eyes to sense things about its opponents—like their body heat—then attacks once it identifies a weak spot.

text.name: Bring Down
text.text: Choose a Pokémon in play (yours or your opponent's) that has the least HP remaining, except for this Pokémon, and it is Knocked Out.

text.name: Water Shot
text.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

name: Alakazam
flavor_text: Alakazam wields potent psychic powers. It’s said that this Pokémon used these powers to create the spoons it holds.

text.name: Psychic Draw
text.text: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may use this Ability. Draw 3 cards.

text.name: Powerful Hand
text.text: Place 2 damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon for each card in your hand.

name: Lunatone
flavor_text: It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike 40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.

text.name: Lunar Cycle
text.text: Once during your turn, if you have Solrock in play, you may discard a Basic {F} Energy card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Draw 3 cards. You can't use more than 1 Lunar Cycle Ability each turn.

name: Drifloon
flavor_text: It is whispered that any child who mistakes Drifloon for a balloon and holds on to it could wind up missing.

text.name: Pull
text.text: Flip a coin. If heads, switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.

name: Drifblim
flavor_text: It can generate and release gas within its body. That’s how it can control the altitude of its drift.

text.name: Creepy Wind
text.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

text.name: Balloon Return
text.text: Put this Pokémon and all attached cards into your hand.

name: Psyduck
flavor_text: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.

text.name: Damp
text.text: Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) lose any Ability that requires the Pokémon using it to Knock Out itself.

name: Golduck
flavor_text: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins to glow.

text.name: Damp
text.text: Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) lose any Ability that requires the Pokémon using it to Knock Out itself.

text.name: Hydro Pump
text.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each {W} Energy attached to this Pokémon.

name: Alakazam
flavor_text: Alakazam wields potent psychic powers. It’s said that this Pokémon used these powers to create the spoons it holds.

text.name: Psychic Draw
text.text: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may use this Ability. Draw 3 cards.

text.name: Powerful Hand
text.text: Place 2 damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon for each card in your hand.

name: Riolu
flavor_text: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

text.name: Accelerating Stab
text.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Accelerating Stab.

text.name: Strafe
text.text: You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

text.name: Illusory Impulse
text.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

text.name: Mega Evolution ex Rule
text.text: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

text.name: Aura Jab
text.text: Attach up to 3 Basic {F} Energy cards from your discard pile to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like.

text.name: Mega Brave
text.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Mega Brave.

text.name: Mega Evolution ex Rule
text.text: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

text.name: Solar Transfer
text.text: As often as you like during your turn, you may use this Ability. Move a Basic {G} Energy from 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.

text.name: Jungle Dump
text.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

text.name: Mega Evolution ex Rule
text.text: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

name: Ceruledge
flavor_text: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.

text.name: Infernal Slash
text.text: Discard 4 Basic {R} Energy cards from your hand. If you can't discard 4 cards in this way, this attack does nothing.

name: Zacian
flavor_text: Able to cut down anything with a single strike, it became known as the Fairy King’s Sword, and it inspired awe in friend and foe alike.

text.name: Limit Break
text.text: If your opponent has 3 or fewer Prize cards remaining, this attack does 90 more damage.

name: Flygon
flavor_text: Known as the Desert Spirit, this Pokémon hides in the sandstorms it causes by beating its wings.

text.name: Sandy Flapping
text.text: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may use this Ability. You may also use this Ability if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon. Discard the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck.

name: Toxtricity
flavor_text: As it scatters toxic sweat and emits electricity, a melody that sounds like it came from a guitar reverberates through the surrounding area.

text.name: Sinister Surge
text.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Search your deck for a Basic {D} Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Benched {D} Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. If you attached Energy to a Pokémon in this way, place 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.

name: Cottonee
flavor_text: Pillows and beds stuffed with cotton exhaled by Cottonee are soft and puffy, light and airy— altogether top quality.

text.name: Collect
text.text: Draw a card.

name: Whimsicott
flavor_text: Like the wind, it can slip through any gap, no matter how small. It leaves balls of white fluff behind.

text.name: Healing Fluff
text.text: Heal all damage from 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

text.name: U-turn
text.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

name: Sneasel
flavor_text: This cunning Pokémon hides under the cover of darkness, waiting to attack its prey.

name: Weavile
flavor_text: Evolution made it even more devious. It communicates by clawing signs in boulders.

text.name: Retaliatory Claw
text.text: If this Pokémon's remaining HP is 50 or less, this attack does 170 more damage.

name: Charcadet
flavor_text: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

text.name: Gather Strength
text.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

text.name: Inferno X
text.text: Discard any amount of {R} Energy from among your Pokémon, and this attack does 90 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

text.name: Mega Evolution ex Rule
text.text: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

text.name: Excited Turbo
text.text: As often as you like during your turn, if you have any {R} Mega Evolution Pokémon ex in play, you may use this Ability. Attach a Basic {R} Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Benched {R} Pokémon.

text.name: Pokémon ex rule
text.text: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Run Errand
text.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may use this Ability. Draw 2 cards. You can't use more than 1 Run Errand Ability each turn.

text.name: Rapid-Fire Combo
text.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 50 more damage for each heads.

text.name: Mega Evolution ex Rule
text.text: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

name: Meloetta
flavor_text: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

text.name: Soothing Melody
text.text: Heal 120 damage from 1 of your Benched {P} Pokémon.

name: Haunter
flavor_text: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

text.text: Once during each player's turn, that player may heal 10 damage from each of their Pokémon. If a player healed any damage in this way, their turn ends.
You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can’t be played.
